forklifts.name: Toyota 8FBN 1.5T Electric
forklifts.bestFor: Indoor warehousing, smooth floors, cold storage, food manufacturing
forklifts.note: Toyota 8FBN AC electric forklift — zero emissions, quiet, and extremely energy efficient. Features Toyota SAS™ (System of Active Stability) for tip-over prevention. Available with Li-ion or lead-acid battery. 6.7m lift height standard mast. ⚠️ Rated 1,500kg at 500mm load centre — capacity reduces significantly at height. Check the Toyota load plate before committing.
forklifts.liftChart: 1,500kg at 500mm load centre and ground level. Capacity reduces with height: verify Toyota 8FBN load plate for your specific mast and load height combination.

forklifts.name: Toyota 8FBN 2.0T Electric
forklifts.bestFor: Indoor warehousing, smooth concrete, manufacturing, cool rooms
forklifts.note: Toyota 8FBN 2.0T — Australia's most popular electric forklift class. SAS™ stability, ergonomic operator compartment. Li-ion option available. ⚠️ 2.0T rated at 500mm load centre at ground — confirm capacity on Toyota load plate before use at height or with extended load centres.
forklifts.liftChart: 2,000kg at 500mm load centre at ground. Capacity reduces with height and extended load centres — refer to Toyota 8FBN 2T load plate.

telehandlers.name: JCB 531-70 7m 3.1T Telehandler
telehandlers.bestFor: Construction sites, agriculture, yard work, rough terrain
telehandlers.note: JCB 531-70 telehandler — versatile 7m reach with 3.1T capacity at max height. Powerful JCB EcoMAX engine, all-wheel-steer for tight spots. Approved for use with personnel cage. Compatible with wide range of JCB attachments. ⚠️ Capacity reduces with forward reach. Always check JCB load chart before picking at full extension.
